newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes lower, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes lower, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly lower on Tuesday in increased trade lifted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 557.48, down from 559.42 on Monday.
Volume was 1.14 million dinars against 425,534 dinars. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 745,700 dinars.
UIB bank rose 0.2 dinar to 11.5 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix slipped 0.96 dinar to 32.54 dinars. Airline TUNISAIR fell 0.22 dinar to 15.6 and BTEI bank edged down 0.18 dinar to 21.56.
